papers.title_en: Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions
papers.authors: Sylvain Dehayem Kenfouo, Aaron Zweig, Mingxuan Zhang, Elham Azizi
papers.evidence: 面向图像生成的免训练采样优化
papers.tldr: 条件扩散模型能生成与提示高度一致的高质量图像，但不同随机种子下的样本仍可能视觉相似，限制创意探索。现有方法提升多样性常需额外优化或采样开销，强扰动还会损害质量与对齐。本文提出免训练方法，利用条件嵌入到图像空间映射的局部拉回几何，识别输出最敏感方向，并沿这些方向引导不同采样轨迹。在MS-COCO与BrushNet上，该方法提升了提示条件生成与修复的多样性，同时保持条件一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

papers.title_en: Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Lei Zhu, Mujie Lin, Ruochong Zheng, Guangyi Wang, Hao Li, Peng Jin, Chang Liu, Jie Chen
papers.tldr: 扩散模型推理因重复去噪评估而昂贵，免训练特征缓存虽可加速，却常因泰勒外推不稳定和局部误差累积受限。BeziCast 用低阶 Bezier 轨迹预测靠近输出的去噪表示，并通过 Tikhonov 稳定拟合控制点，辅以凸包启发式护栏抑制激进外推。实验在图像和视频扩散模型上取得最高 4.79 倍与 4.11 倍加速，且生成质量明显优于竞争基线。它为无需重训的扩散加速提供了更稳定、可部署的缓存预测方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

papers.title_en: Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration
papers.authors: Jiyue Jiang, Zhiyu Huo, Yuhan Chen, Yanruisheng Shao, Gong Zhang, Lei Deng
papers.evidence: 面向视频扩散加速的免训练校准缓存
papers.tldr: 视频扩散模型的特征缓存可免训练加速，但现有自适应方法用启发式差异度量、全局阈值且不校验预算误差，导致调度偏差。AlignCache 将去噪轨迹分阶段路由预算，并用闭环阈值校准与动量增强草稿合成对齐真实生成影响。在多个先进视频生成模型上取得更优加速-质量权衡，把缓存调度变为自校正控制器。
papers.abstract_en: Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

papers.title_en: AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Javad Rajabi, Koorosh Roohi, David B. Lindell, Babak Taati
papers.evidence: 用于高效高分辨率扩散Transformer图像生成的免训练注意力
papers.tldr: 高分辨率扩散Transformer生成超出训练分辨率的图像时，token数量激增使全注意力成本呈二次增长，并因相对距离超出训练范围引发结构失真和细节退化。AReA是一种免训练注意力机制，让感受野随去噪过程由粗到细演化：早期用下采样键值的跨尺度粗注意力捕获全局结构，后期在逐步收缩的窗口内做局部注意力以精修细节。实验表明，无需额外参数或训练，AReA在多种目标分辨率和模型上稳定优于现有免训练基线，同时速度更快、效率更高。
papers.abstract_en: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.

papers.title_en: Beyond Pairwise Repulsion: Collective Diversity via Determinant Maximization in Diffusion Sampling
papers.authors: Kwanyoung Lee, SeungJu Cha, Yebin Ahn, Sungho Koh, Dong-Jin Kim
papers.evidence: 扩散采样中的行列式噪声优化
papers.tldr: 强引导的文本到图像扩散采样会把不同噪声收敛到近乎相同的视觉原型，损害合成数据增强所需的分布多样性。作者指出多样性是整批样本的集合性质，提出DetNO，在一步Tweedie预测上最大化RBF Gram矩阵的对数行列式（即批次体积），并加锚点保真项，用单一超参数λ权衡多样性—质量。在SD1.5、SDXL、SD3上，DetNO的批内VendiScore与平均自相似度领先，少样本分类精度显著提升。该免训练、免改采样器的方法表明集合级目标优于成对排斥。
papers.abstract_en: Strong guidance in text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models concentrates sampling toward high-density modes of the conditional distribution, collapsing independently sampled noise vectors onto nearly identical visual prototypes. This limits utility for tasks that demand distributional breadth, most critically synthetic data augmentation. Diversity, however, is a collective property of the whole batch: a set can preserve every pairwise distance yet still collapse onto a low-dimensional subspace. Existing sum-of-pairwise noise-optimization and repulsion objectives respond only weakly to this higher-order failure. We propose DetNO (Determinant Noise Optimization), which formulates diverse generation as RKHS volume maximization on the initial noise, maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over one-step Tweedie predictions. This set-level functional equals the squared batch volume; its repulsion is strongest when the batch is most collapsed and self-attenuates as diversity is achieved. An anchor-based fidelity term keeps the optimized noises near plausible regions, and Lagrangian relaxation gives a two-term objective with a single hyperparameter $λ$ governing the diversity-quality trade-off, without training or sampler modification. Across three backbones (SD1.5, SDXL, SD3), DetNO achieves leading intra-batch diversity in VendiScore and Mean Self-Similarity, and a downstream few-shot classification experiment confirms that broader mode coverage brings statistically significant accuracy gains for synthetic data augmentation in the low-shot regime. Fixing the pipeline and varying only the batch objective, both RBF-based aggregators outperform InfoNCE, and the log-determinant attains the best downstream accuracy on both benchmarks. Its diversity advantage over InfoNCE widens as the batch grows. Code is available at https://github.com/mobled37/DetNO.

papers.title_en: Which Tokens to Merge? Diffusion Dynamics for Efficient Image Generation
papers.authors: SeungJu Cha, Ye-Chan Kim, HyunGee Kim, Sungho Koh, Dong-Jin Kim
papers.evidence: 面向高效扩散图像生成的免训练Token合并
papers.tldr: 扩散模型加速中，token合并需判断哪些token可安全合并，现有文本相关性准则忽略背景与局部细节，易损伤结构连贯。DaTMe将合并决策建立在扩散动力学上，利用Tweedie去噪估计构建重要性图，融合步间时间变化与局部高频结构信号，并按压缩率分配锚点与安全合并候选。在PixArt-a与FLUX上，该方法保持全图视觉保真，为免训练高效生成提供token级合并新依据。
papers.abstract_en: Token merging has emerged as an effective training-free strategy for accelerating diffusion models by reducing redundant token computation while minimizing generation degradation. A key challenge is determining which tokens can be safely merged and which should be preserved for subsequent computation. Existing method addresses this by preserving prompt-aligned foreground regions, thereby protecting semantically relevant structures. However, this text-relevance criterion overlooks background objects, local details that are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, leading to degraded structural coherence. In this work, we propose Dynamics-aware Token Merging (DaTMe), a training-free framework that grounds token merging in the underlying diffusion dynamics. Our key insight is that token importance should reflect whether a token remains unresolved during denoising and whether it carries structural information. To this end, DaTMe constructs a dynamics- aware importance map from the Tweedie denoised estimate. The map combines a temporal signal, measuring inter-step changes in the predicted clean image, with a structural signal, capturing local high-frequency content such as boundaries and fine details. Using this map, DaTMe adaptively assigns tokens into merging roles under a given compression ratio: important tokens are preserved as anchors, while tokens that are both temporally stabilized and structurally homogeneous are selected as safe merge candidates. Experiments on PixArt-a and FLUX demonstrate that DaTMe maintains visual fidelity across the entire image, highlighting diffusion dynamics as an effective token-level merging decision in efficient generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/SeungJuCha/DaTMe.

papers.title_en: AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation
papers.evidence: 基于扩散模型的免训练提示驱动音视频编辑
papers.tldr: 现有联合音视频扩散模型虽能生成同步内容，但编辑已有片段时难以在不破坏非目标结构与跨模态对应关系的前提下完成目标修改。AV-FlowEdit提出无需训练、无需反演的提示驱动音视频编辑框架，利用源-目标流差异同时提供编辑方向与保持线索，并在共享扰动下联合更新视频与音频分支。方法引入跨模态事件感知频谱轨迹保持，结合流显著性、对齐音频活动、多尺度低频位移与扩散阶段调度来抑制采样漂移。实验显示其提示对齐与时序一致性较强，音频质量和跨模态连贯性具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.

papers.title_en: TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance
papers.authors: Zhuo Chen, Bin Zou, Fanyue Wei, Lixin Duan, Angela Yao, Wen Li
papers.evidence: 利用历史轨迹引导加速自回归视频扩散
papers.tldr: 自回归视频扩散在仅剩四步去噪时，现有特征缓存因时间步间特征变化大而失效。TGuide发现不同视频块在相同去噪时间步上的特征高度相关，据此提出Anchor-Transport-Correct预测器，融合当前块前一步特征与上一块同时间步特征，经空间检索与自适应校正提升速度预测精度。在Self Forcing等模型上实现最高1.89倍去噪加速且保持质量。
papers.abstract_en: Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

papers.title_en: Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Tiantian Liu, Meng Wan, Zhiqiang Liang, Jue Wang, Ningming Nie, Yangang Wang
papers.evidence: 面向视频扩散Transformer的免训练稀疏注意力
papers.tldr: 免训练稀疏注意力可加速视频扩散Transformer推理，但现有方法让每个注意力头固定同一竞争域，忽视头间异质性。EG-Sparse按熵路由：低熵头用跨头分组池，高熵头保留逐行局部选择，且仅复用稀疏流程已算分数。诊断显示该分组使低熵头重构误差降9.8%，强制高熵头入全头全局池则升7.9%；四种配置下视频质量更高、注意力密度与GPU去噪延迟更低。该工作将竞争域适配确立为免训练稀疏注意力的独立设计轴。
papers.abstract_en: Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

papers.title_en: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.authors: Jiahui Hu, Weile Mo, Peiliang Cai, Jiacheng Liu, Jinkui Ren, Xiantao Zhang, Xiaobing Tu, Linfeng Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向自回归视频生成的免训练预测式KV缓存量化
papers.tldr: 自回归视频扩散模型支持长视频流式生成，但KV cache快速增长带来显著显存开销，现有LLM量化方法迁移效果差。TempoKV利用视频KV cache的时间可预测性与键值不对称性，按键和值不同依赖分别预测，并仅低精度存储残差，无需训练。在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上，其生成质量优于现有KV cache量化方法，最高实现6.71倍压缩。该工作为自回归视频生成提供高效、免训练的KV cache压缩方案。
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

papers.title_en: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Wuzhe Xu, Zhaiming Shen, Yulong Lu, Wenjing Liao, Rongjie Lai
papers.evidence: 无需重训练或参数更新即可在未见任务上采样
papers.tldr: 扩散模型通常只学习单一分布或训练时固定的条件分布族，难以仅凭少量样本适应未见分布。作者把每个目标分布视为元分布中的任务，在推理时用上下文样本定义任务，学习将上下文、噪声查询点和扩散时间映射为任务相关分数的上下文分数算子。该算子通过摊销去噪分数匹配训练，并配有泛化误差界。实验在Navier-Stokes、ERA5、QuickDraw和Food-101上进行，简单任务族表现良好，复杂任务性能下降。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a model in our constructed transformer class, providing a principled foundation for the proposed query-dependent attention architecture. The operator is trained through amortized denoising score matching across task distributions. We establish generalization-error bounds that quantify the effects of the context size, the numbers of training tasks and within-task samples, model complexity, and intrinsic and ambient dimensions. Numerically, we evaluate the method on a range of scientific and visual datasets, including Navier-Stokes, ERA5 climate data, QuickDraw sketches, and Food-101. The results show that the proposed method performs well on relatively simple task families, while its performance degrades as task complexity increases, thereby illustrating both the promise and the limitations of in-context learning for diffusion models.

papers.title_en: GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation
papers.authors: Yeobin Hong, Hyojun Go, Dohun Lee, Jeongjae Lee, Sunghwan Hong, Federico Tombari, Zhaochong An, Jong Chul Ye, Konrad Schindler, Dominik Narnhofer
papers.evidence: 面向视频扩散的推理时奖励对齐，无需后训练
papers.tldr: 视频扩散模型常被用作4D生成先验，但生成视频的几何一致性不足；现有几何奖励后训练易损纹理细节，还需额外外观奖励与调参。GeoFix提出统一框架，仅用单一几何奖励衡量静态区域跨视角深度一致性，并按相机视场重叠趋势校准奖励，支持训练与推理时对齐。实验在WorldScore 3D一致性提升39%、VBench质量分提升4%，说明其可同时改善几何与视觉质量。
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

papers.title_en: Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework
papers.authors: Hannah Janmohamed, Joao Correia, Penousal Machado, Antoine Cully
papers.evidence: 质量-多样性优化与扩散采样结合
papers.tldr: 扩散模型采样天然偏向高似然区域，导致输出多样性受限，而许多领域需要多样化的高性能样本组合。为此，作者将质量-多样性（QD）优化与扩散模型结合，提出 Quality-Diversity Diffusion，直接优化潜噪声与条件嵌入，并用嵌入模型量化多样性。进一步引入基于输入-激活雅可比主奇异向量的 h-space 谱变异算子，引导搜索沿语义最敏感方向进行。在文本到图像生成任务上，该方法对比12个基线取得最低FID，兼顾图像质量与多样性。
papers.abstract_en: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. Second, we introduce a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, which guides search along directions of maximal semantic sensitivity by analysing principal singular vectors of the model's input-to-activation Jacobian. We evaluate our combined approach, Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion, on text-to-image generation. Against 12 baselines, our method consistently achieves the lowest FID score, demonstrating an excellent balance of image quality and diversity.

papers.title_en: Score Mismatch and Set-Constrained Sampling in Zero-Shot Conditional Discrete Diffusion
papers.authors: Renxiang Huang, Yuchen Liang, Yingbin Liang, Ness Shroff, Lifeng Lai
papers.evidence: 离散扩散的免训练零样本条件采样
papers.tldr: 离散扩散在零样本条件生成中常面临训练与目标分布不一致导致的分数失配。论文首次给出失配离散扩散的理论分析，推导KL散度上界并刻画部分观测与坐标集合约束下的偏差。作者提出随机硬钳制RHC采样器，用吸收率下的无条件分数精确表达赋值概率。实验表明RHC能有效缓解维度、词表规模与兼容性带来的偏差，为相关采样提供理论依据与实用算法。
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have become a powerful framework for modeling complex discrete distributions across a range of applications. While theoretical convergence guarantees depend on consistency between the target and training distributions, such a case rarely holds in practice, making score mismatch a central challenge in discrete diffusion sampling. This is particularly relevant to zero-shot conditional generation, where a model trained on the unconditional distribution is directly reused at inference time to sample from a conditional target distribution. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis for score-mismatched discrete diffusion models and derive a general KL divergence upper bound that clearly identifies the additional bias caused by such a mismatch. Our analysis covers partial-observation constraints, including text infilling, sentence completion, and more general coordinatewise set constraints. Specifically, we analyze the classical Conditional SEDD sampler and show that it can incur a bias term that scales with the dimension, vocabulary size, and compatibility. Based on this analysis, we propose a Randomized Hard Clamping (RHC) sampler for coordinatewise set constraints. We show that the assignment probabilities can be expressed exactly by the unconditional scores with absorbing rate. Finally, numerical and real-data experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed RHC sampler.

papers.title_en: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation with Semantic-Geometric Alignment for Generative Inbetweening
papers.authors: Zhiyu Xu, Wei Shang, Yushen Xu, Wenwen Li, Zhiyan Xu, Pengfei Zhu, Dongwei Ren
papers.evidence: 适配预训练视频扩散做中间帧生成
papers.tldr: 生成式补帧需在首尾帧间合成时序连贯的中间帧，但预训练图生视频扩散模型缺乏显式目标帧约束，大位移和非刚性运动下易漂移或不稳定。DSG-GI通过目标条件适配沿生成轨迹提供渐进式目标引导，并用语义-几何对齐约束骨干特征与冻结视频基础编码器的时空关系几何。标准与大运动基准实验显示，其在时序稳定性、目标帧忠实度和感知质量上均有提升。该工作为可控大运动补帧提供了更可靠的目标导向生成框架。
papers.abstract_en: Generative inbetweening aims to synthesize temporally coherent intermediate frames between a start frame and a target frame. Although pretrained image-to-video diffusion models provide strong priors for large-motion inbetweening, they are not explicitly designed to reach a specified target frame. They may therefore generate realistic individual frames while drifting from the target or producing unstable motion under large displacements and non-rigid dynamics. We propose DSG-GI, a framework that adapts pretrained latent video diffusion models through \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation and \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment. Destination-Conditioned Adaptation treats the target frame as the destination of the sequence and provides temporally progressive guidance along the generated trajectory. Semantic-Geometric Alignment aligns the token-wise spatio-temporal relational geometry of backbone features with that of a frozen video foundation encoder and applies a flow-matching-aware latent flow constraint to samples near the data endpoint of the probability path. Together, these components strengthen destination guidance and preserve coherent semantic-geometric motion structure. Extensive experiments on standard and large-motion inbetweening benchmarks demonstrate improvements in temporal stability, target-frame faithfulness, and perceptual quality. Our code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: MOSAIC: Mode- and Support-Aware Inference-Time Control of Robot Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Sabrina Bodmer, Rahel Rickenbach, René Zurbrügg, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Colin Jones
papers.evidence: 机器人扩散模型的免梯度推理时控制
papers.tldr: 扩散生成策略虽能提供表达能力强的机器人行为先验，但部署时的约束和目往往超出训练分布。MOSAIC提出无梯度的推理时控制框架，把初始噪声与反向采样扰动视为联合输入，用全去噪输出的重要性权重自适应调整其分布。在导航、灵巧抓取、未知几何运动规划与协作搬箱任务上，它无需重训练即可适配并组合多个冻结扩散先验。
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies such as diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for robot behavior, yet the situations a robot faces at execution time rarely match its training data and impose constraints and objectives the policy never learned. Existing inference-time guidance methods either rely on gradients that can push samples away from the learned prior, or on sampling procedures that can be inefficient, collapse modes, or average them into out-of-distribution predictions.   We introduce MOSAIC, a mode- and support-aware framework for gradient-free inference-time control of robotic diffusion models. MOSAIC treats the initial noise and all stochastic reverse-step perturbations as a joint input to the pretrained denoising process and adapts a distribution over this input using importance weights computed from fully denoised outputs. Physical feasibility and consistency with the learned support are balanced using adaptive penalties, while mode-wise importance-weighted updates preserve modes and avoid destructive averaging.   The same formulation can jointly steer multiple independently trained diffusion models through shared coupling costs, enabling coordinated behavior without requiring a joint model. We evaluate MOSAIC on navigation, dexterous grasping, motion planning with unseen geometry, and collaborative box manipulation with independently trained robot priors. Across these settings, MOSAIC adapts and composes frozen diffusion priors under new deployment constraints without retraining.

papers.title_en: LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Zipeng Wang, Anping Xiong, Jing Zhang, Xiaoya Zhu, Yi Jiang, Yanbing Xiao, Zige Zeng, Zezhou Chen, Xiang Liu, Huan Hu, Ping Chen, Kai Wang, Zhaoxiang Liu, Shiguo Lian, Ye LV, Fang Zhao, Huanlin Gao, Zhengrui Huang, Bo Shen, Yuren You
papers.evidence: 测试时循环深度改进扩散图像生成
papers.tldr: 扩散Transformer测试时复用共享块可增加计算，但朴素循环会损害生成。LoopREG用预训练视觉编码器监督共享块重复访问的表示，训练时仅在最后一次循环后对齐，推理时把同一算子外推到更多访问。在ImageNet 256×256上，SiT-B/2的FID从15.08降至4.91，训练两访问的检查点加一次推理访问也从14.71降至5.34。该工作表明表示监督循环可把额外推理深度转化为生成质量提升。
papers.abstract_en: Reusing Transformer blocks offers a way to increase diffusion-model computation at test time, but naive recurrence can degrade generation beyond its training depth. We introduce LoopREG, a representation-supervised recurrent diffusion Transformer that repeatedly applies a shared block at the state supervised by a pretrained visual encoder. Alignment is applied after the final recurrent visit during training; inference extends the same learned operator to additional visits. On ImageNet 256 x 256, LoopREG reduces SiT-B/2 FID from the local REG baseline's 15.08 to 4.91 at 400K training steps, a 67.41% reduction. Within a checkpoint trained with two visits, one extra inference visit improves FID from 14.71 to 5.34 with unchanged weights. The benefit persists on SiT-L/2 and SiT-XL/2. Controlled interventions show that useful recurrence follows the location of representation supervision, while REPA alignment produces a smaller extrapolation benefit. These results make representation-supervised recurrence a practical route to improving diffusion generation through additional inference depth.
